title: Governance Drift: Reproducibility Package
description: Manuscript source, closed-world detector study, canonical results, and an executed bounded Kubernetes/GitOps laboratory for Governance Drift. Version 1.1.0 reports one controlled execution of each of nine scenarios on a pinned Kind/Flux/Kyverno stack (9/9 expected class-resolved verdicts; observed latency 0.137–8.571 seconds), adds a risk-channel severity taxonomy, and adds a comparative native-scope matrix. The live results demonstrate feasibility and occurrence on one stack; they do not estimate prevalence, reliability, production effectiveness, or latency distributions.
